appliesTo: All advised investment and pension cases

queries.text: risks and disadvantages of the recommendation you should be aware

triggerProbe.presentWhen: Always — the check applies to all advised cases.

queryGroups.requirement: Material disadvantages, risk factors and limitations of the recommendation

queries.text: disadvantages of this recommendation you should note the following drawbacks
other considerations of switching things to bear in mind
time out of the market while the transfer is pending could be financially disadvantaged
delays in accessing funds working days for disinvestment and banking
previous provider is not obliged to take the plan back cancellation limitations

comparison.tolerance: Every material disadvantage identified in research or product literature should appear in the report.
falsePositiveGuards: Disadvantages may be spread across several sections rather than collected under one heading — retrieve broadly before concluding they are absent.
A risk disclosed in the illustration but omitted from the report is a report gap only where it is material to this client.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern: a report presenting only benefits is not fair, clear and not misleading.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Assess on the report alone; note the absence of research or product literature to test completeness against.

queries.text: the value of your investment can fall as well as rise you may get back less than invested
past performance is not a guide to future returns no guarantee of outperformance
risk factors listed in the key features document and KIID for this fund
queries.note: The source list against which the report's risk coverage is tested.

queries.text: risks specific to drawdown income sustainability capital erosion longevity
inflation risk interest rate risk currency risk concentration risk

falsePositiveGuards: Standard capital-at-risk wording satisfies the general warning but not product-specific risks — test them separately.
Deferring risk disclosure to product literature ('all other risks are detailed in the literature provided') is a limitation on the report, and should be recorded as such.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Note that no product literature is on file to verify risk coverage against.

queries.text: tax implications of this recommendation income tax on withdrawals marginal rate
inheritance tax treatment of pensions on death before and after age 75
tax analysis of the recommended action carried out in research
triggering the money purchase annual allowance by taking taxable income
queries.note: A withdrawal recommendation that does not address MPAA consequences is a common omission.

falsePositiveGuards: Generic legislative explanation is not the same as stating the consequence for this client — distinguish the two.
A tax consequence stated without the client's tax band established (see CHK-001 G1.2) is unverifiable, not necessarily wrong.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern where the recommendation has a tax consequence (encashment, crystallisation, contribution).

queries.text: what would happen if your investment fell by twenty or thirty percent
stress test market crash scenario modelled in the cashflow
illustration showing lower growth rate projected value

falsePositiveGuards: A stress test in a cashflow model is a loss scenario even if not labelled as one in the risk section.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: Potential Concern: loss scenarios are explicitly named by this check.

queryGroups.requirement: Disadvantages and risks are fairly and prominently presented

queries.text: risk warnings section heading important information you should read
appendix technical notes assumptions and definitions
queries.note: Establishes whether material risk content sits only in an appendix, which is the prominence test in COBS 4.2.1R.

queries.text: benefits of the recommendation summarised positively
queries.note: Retrieved to compare the weight and placement of benefits against disadvantages.

falsePositiveGuards: Chunk ordering does not reliably reflect page position — rely on explicit section headings and page markers, not retrieval order.
A dedicated risk section is not mandatory; disadvantages distributed but clearly stated can still be prominent.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Record that no dedicated risk or disadvantages section exists and note where risk content was found instead.

decision.noIssue: Material disadvantages, product and investment risks, tax consequences and at least one loss scenario are stated in the report, consistent with the research and product literature, and presented where the client will see them.
decision.potentialConcern: A material disadvantage or risk identified in the file is absent from the report, tax consequences are unaddressed, no loss scenario is given, or risk content appears only in an appendix while benefits are prominent.
decision.notApplicable: Not applicable — this check applies to all advised investment and pension cases.
severityHints: Highest: a material disadvantage present in research or product literature and omitted entirely from the report.
High: no disadvantages stated at all, or risk disclosure wholly delegated to product literature.
High: a recommendation with a tax cost whose consequence is never explained.
Moderate: risks stated only in generic boilerplate with nothing product-specific.
Low: risk content present but scattered rather than collected.
